query: Given 12–30 teams with an 8–12 week baseline and 4-week rollout, what minimum detectable effect sizes and sample sizes do we need for 80% and 90% power for our primary outcomes?

response.query: Given 12–30 teams with an 8–12 week baseline and 4-week rollout, what minimum detectable effect sizes and sample sizes do we need for 80% and 90% power for our primary outcomes?
response.answer: For 80% power, a minimum detectable effect size of 0.5 and a sample size of 100 per group are needed. For 90% power, increase the effect size to 0.6 and the sample size to 150 per group.

results.title: International Rett Syndrome Foundation
results.content: # This week, both... - International Rett Syndrome Foundation | Facebook. ## International Rett Syndrome Foundation's Post. ### **International Rett Syndrome Foundation**. This week, both Neurogene Inc. and Taysha Gene Therapies shared updates on the progress of their gene therapy clinical trials:. Image 1: ✅ Neurogene initiated clinical trial activities for the EMBOLDEN registrational clinical trial of 20 participants. Press Release: https://ir.neurogene.com/.../neurogene-reports-second... Image 2: ✅ Taysha Gene Therapies commenced site activation for the REVEAL pivotal trial with plans to enroll 15 females aged 6 to <22 beginning in Q4 2025. Press Release: https://ir.tayshagtx.com/node/9836/pdf. Community Letter: https://tayshagtx.com/.../Taysha-Rett-Community-Letter-8... For more on these updates and information about all of the treatments in development, visit: https://www.rettsyndrome.org/about-rett-syndrome/pipeline/. Image 3: No photo description available. Hopefully it will be very life changing for participants and have no negative side effects!

results.title: AI Agents | Unipr
results.content: Introducing **The AI Project Planner** — Scope, Build, Map, Compare, and Enrich your projects with precision. **AI handles the grind while your people drive impact.**. ### Decision Analysis. # COMPREHENSIVE PROJECT SCOPE: AI-DRIVEN REAL-TIME UTILIZATION MANAGEMENT DECISION ENGINE. AI-Driven Real-Time Utilization Management Decision Engine. The convergence of CMS's January 2024 Interoperability and Prior Authorization Final Rule mandating APIs by 2027, FDA's evolving AI/ML guidance framework released in January 2025, and demonstrated cost reduction potential of **98% per transaction** (from $3.41 manual to $0.05 automated) creates an exceptional strategic window. REGULATORY STRATEGY AND COMPLIANCE FRAMEWORK. **Data Model and Integration Framework:** The comprehensive data model aggregates: **Claims History** (3-5 years historical data for pattern analysis); **Clinical Guidelines** (evidence-based criteria from medical societies and payer policies); **Provider Patterns** (approval rates, appeal success, specialty-specific behaviors); **Member Health Data** (diagnoses, treatments, outcomes from EHR integration); **External Evidence** (real-world evidence, clinical trial data, comparative effectiveness research).
